steps.sub: Branch height = how far apart groups were at merge

code:
Z = linkage(Xs, method="ward")
print(Z.shape)           # (299, 4) -- one row per merge
print(Z[-3:, 2].round(2))
# [4.31, 22.46, 24.31] -- last 2 merges are MUCH taller
caption: That jump is the tree telling you there are three natural groups.

code:
labels = fcluster(Z, t=3, criterion="maxclust")
print(np.bincount(labels)[1:])   # [100 100 100]

ag = AgglomerativeClustering(n_clusters=3, linkage="ward").fit(Xs)
# silhouette: 0.773 -- identical to k-means on this clean data
caption: fcluster labels start at 1 -- drop the empty first bincount slot.
